fields.label: Balance
fields.description: EGP, whole units (matches this app's existing convention of not tracking piasters anywhere). Mutated ONLY server-side by souq_masr.api.v1.payments' internal _credit/_debit helpers, using ignore_permissions writes — see the DocType permissions: owner gets read=1 only, never write, so there is no client-reachable path to change a balance directly, ever.
